# TX Reference Sheet

Source: [wiki article 9562](../archive/9562.md); edited 2026-08-27.

<a id="wiki-9562-n1"></a>

- Documented texture/icon identifiers are tx codes, insertable with Custom String after obtaining an unsanitized opening bracket via linked TX/FG technique.

<a id="wiki-9562-n2"></a>

- Example uses Custom String("{0}tx CODE>", Global.bracket); omit literal opening bracket because variable supplies it.

<a id="wiki-9562-n3"></a>

- Catalog groups role, communication, ability/passive, upgrade, Stadium, gallery/currency, mode, lobby, flag, input, progression and miscellaneous assets with names/tags and sometimes TX Browser page numbers.

<a id="wiki-9562-n4"></a>

- Source explicitly says list incomplete, unsorted, and IDs may change on any update; provenance is TX Browser code 8B9H1.

<a id="wiki-9562-n5"></a>

- Catalog contains retired/passive/alternate-form art beyond normal Ability Icon String mappings; texture existence does not imply associated gameplay support.

Data: [normalized factual tables](../tables/9562.md).
